name: Annoying Customer
source: She was a very rude customer that visited the store [url=/c167374]Kenpachi[/url] worked at the day his powers awakened. Her card was rejected when she tried buying eighty dollars worth of condoms, and she blamed Kenpachi for it. [spoiler]Much later, during the meeting with the Mayor, Kenpachi learned that she was [url=/c167614]Mayor Winters[/url]'s wife[/spoiler]
